chunks: They said: 'O our father, why do you not trust us with Joseph, while we are indeed his well-wishers?'
ai.seo_question: Why did Jacob hesitate to let Joseph go with his brothers?
ai.summary: In this verse, Jacob’s brothers appeal to his paternal affection, arguing that their genuine care for Joseph justifies his inclusion in their journey. Shia exegetes often highlight this as a moment of rhetorical manipulation, where their outward sincerity masks the inner deceit that leads to Joseph’s eventual exile. This interaction underscores the theme of divine wisdom operating through human agency, even amidst familial discord.
